---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a concrete project improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the user or research problem. Explain why the current behavior is not
sufficient and link related issues or `TODO.md` items.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest observable outcome that would solve the problem. Include
acceptance criteria, not only an implementation idea.

## Alternatives and non-goals

List alternatives considered and anything this request should intentionally not
cover.

## Verification

Explain how the outcome can be tested or reproduced. For experiment changes,
include the required dataset, configuration, seeds, metrics, and compute limits.

## Additional context

Add relevant examples, constraints, or references.
